claims.claim: Very neat 2 seater couch for sale
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a cream/beige 2-seater sofa with some light staining/marks on the seat area; upholstery appears slightly worn, though seams/piping look intact and no broken parts are visible.

risks.risk: Material type not confirmed (fabric vs PU vs leather); cleaning/odor risk and true wear level may differ by material.
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the upholstery material (tag/label if any) plus a photo of the back/underside showing material construction.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used fabric/PU sofa with possible cleaning needs and minor cosmetic wear.

risks.risk: Hidden underside/frame issues (wobble, loose joints, broken springs) not visible from the shown angles.
risks.proof: A short video lifting one corner to show underside/frame, legs, and any wobble; plus a photo of the underside joints.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing inspection/repair risk; treated as not guaranteed structurally perfect.

risks.risk: Cushion sag/comfort not verifiable; photos only show surface condition.
risks.proof: A clip of someone pressing down on the seat and releasing to show rebound, plus a side-angle showing cushion thickness.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average/possibly slightly tired cushions (not “like new”).

risks.risk: Stains/marks may be more extensive than visible; odors or deeper soiling could be present.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the full seat panel and arm areas in good light, and a quick smell/odor check confirmation by the buyer in person (video of the seller allowing inspection).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having visible seat marks requiring cleaning.

risks.risk: Dimensions/fit uncertainty for the buyer (may not suit space).
risks.proof: A photo with a measuring tape showing length/width/height and seat height.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as standard 2-seater but with no guarantee of exact fit.

proof_requests: Send exact dimensions (length/width/height) and seat height with a measuring tape in-frame.
Confirm material type (fabric/PU/leather) with a clear close-up and any tag/label.
Provide underside/frame photos and a short video showing the sofa legs and any wobble.
Show cushion rebound: a short clip pressing the seat and releasing.
Upload wider, well-lit photos of the entire seat and arms to confirm the extent of stains/marks.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a 2-seater sofa and the visible condition is consistent with minor cosmetic wear (seat marks) while seams/piping appear intact; a worst-case price can be set without needing unreadable details.
